tools.description: Report which app is in the foreground (scope-filtered).
tools.name: app_foreground

tools.description: Launch one of this run's target apps by package name.
tools.name: app_launch

tools.description: Ask whether one of this run's target apps is installed and its state.
tools.name: app_query

tools.description: Wait until one of this run's target apps is in the foreground.
tools.name: app_wait_foreground

tools.description: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer. kind is text (they type an answer), confirm (yes or no) or choice (they pick one of choices: a list of 2 to 4 short answers).
tools.name: ask_user

tools.description: Claim the goal is done, blocked or failed. The host verifies; claiming is not the verdict.
tools.name: finish

tools.description: Start one of the saved tasks (a macro or a script) the user allowed for this run, by its id, and wait for its result. To give it values, pass inputs as name=value texts, using only the names listed for that task. Status RUNNING means it is still going: never start the same task twice; use task_status with the run_id it gave back to wait for it to end.
tools.name: run_task

tools.description: Check on a saved task that run_task left running: pass the run_id run_task gave back. Waits up to timeout_ms (60 seconds if you give none, at most 120) for the task to end, then gives its status and, once it has ended, its result.
tools.name: task_status

tools.description: Update your scratchpad todo list (kept in context, no device effect).
tools.name: todo_write

tools.name: ui_click

tools.description: Search the current screen for elements whose text or description contains the selector (the words the element shows; case does not matter).
tools.name: ui_find

tools.description: Dismiss the on-screen keyboard if it is showing.
tools.name: ui_hide_keyboard

tools.description: Long-press an element: id is its [n] number on the screen, or selector is the words it shows.
tools.name: ui_long_click

tools.description: Press a device key. Only 'back' is available.
tools.name: ui_press

tools.description: Scroll in a direction until an element whose text or description contains the selector (the words it shows) is visible.
tools.name: ui_scroll_until

tools.description: Type text into an editable element: id is its [n] number on the screen, or selector is the words it shows (never use this for passwords).
tools.name: ui_set_text

tools.description: Capture the current screen as a compact list of visible elements with stable [n] ids for this generation.
tools.name: ui_snapshot

tools.description: Wait until an element whose text or description contains the selector (the words it shows) appears.
tools.name: ui_wait_for

tools.description: Wait until the screen stops changing.
tools.name: ui_wait_for_settle

tools.description: Pause for a short time (max 10 seconds).
